badges.text: needs a Kavat you already own

live.text: wait for night on the Plains

rows.label: Vasca imprint
rows.note: apply one Genetic Code Template on the Orbiter after each infection

conditions: Take your Kavat out at night and let a wild Vasca bite it.
A Kavat downed in one hit doesn't get infected; a bitten one glows red.
Two imprints means infecting the same Kavat twice or two Kavats once. One Kavat gives up to 3 imprints.
Making the imprint cures the infection and consumes the template.
bonuses: Master Teasonai sells a Vasca Kavat Lure for 3,000 standing and a Vasca Kavat Pheromone Oota for 200 standing to call one in.

conditions: Incubation takes 48 hours, or 24 with the Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment.
bonuses: The Market's Vasca Kavat Starter Kit bundles two Vasca imprints, 10 Kavat Genetic Codes, an Incubator Power Core and a Genetic Code Template.
